subtitulo: From a link to a finished video: choose the useful area, write the headlines and generate. It goes to review; it isn't published automatically.

1.ayuda: Paste the link and choose which part shows

2.ayuda: The format decides how everything looks

3.ayuda: Record what you're going to say

5.ayuda: Optional, the text at the top and bottom

errores.sinRuta: The server didn't return where the video was saved. Load the link again.
errores.sinReferencia: The reference to the video was lost. Load the link again.
errores.versionVieja: That edit was saved with an older version of the editor and can no longer be opened.

sinPagina.detalle: The edit is saved as a case file for a page. Choose one in the switcher on the left.

soloLectura.detalle: Your role here doesn't allow creating content. Ask whoever manages it to make you an editor.

render.podesCerrar: You can close the tab: the video keeps rendering on the server and picks up again when you come back. When it's done it goes to review.
render.enRevision: It's waiting in the review queue →

tramo.demasiado: {seg}s is too long for a Reel: Meta allows up to {limite}s. You'll be able to generate it, but it'll be rejected when you publish it as a Reel. And render time grows with the segment.

pegaLink: Paste a TikTok link above to get started
queArmar: What do you want to make

reaccion.detalle: The video on top and you below, both the whole time. The format for commenting on a play as it happens.

comentario.detalle: The video fills the screen and you appear in a circle. To add something without covering it.

simple.detalle: No camera. Just reframe and publish.

subtitulos.detalle: Transcribes what's said —the video and you— and writes it word by word. Adds about half a minute to the render.

listoGenerar: Done — generate the video with the button on the right

reproductor.alInicio: Back to the start of the segment

estilo.guardado: Done: upcoming videos will start like this
estilo.guardar: Save this as the page's style

licencia.conLicencia: The content keeps the license you chose.
licencia.explicacionSinVerificar: A license marked <marca>unverified</marca> is registered with the source link saved. You can sort it out later from <link>Creators</link>.

borrador.error: Couldn't save · will retry on the next change

preview.sinVideo: Load a video to see the result
